resources.string: Import a LiteRT-LM model for private, offline AI translation.
Local AI model imported. It stays on this device.
Could not import this LiteRT-LM model.

Download the 584 MB model over HTTPS? The file is SHA-256 verified and stored privately on this device. It requires about 1 GB of working memory. Gemma is subject to Google’s Gemma Terms of Use and Prohibited Use Policy. The model file is mirrored from a third-party GitHub release; APK Editor Plus is not affiliated with Google.
Model downloaded and selected. It stays on this device.
Import a local AI model in Settings first.
The selected model runs on this device. Translation may be slow and use substantial memory and battery. Continue?

Selected: %1$s\n\nDownload Gemma 3 1B (584 MB), Gemma 4 E2B (2.6 GB), the larger Gemma 4 E4B (3.7 GB; 12 GB RAM recommended), or import a compatible .litertlm file. Models are stored privately and run offline. Only compatible LiteRT-LM bundles are supported.

Download about 2.6 GB over HTTPS in two verified parts? Allow at least 5.5 GB free storage during parallel setup and about 4 GB working memory. The model is stored privately and runs offline. Gemma Terms apply. The checksummed model parts are mirrored by a third party; APK Editor Plus is not affiliated with Google.

This larger model is about 3.66 GB and is downloaded in two SHA-256-verified parts. Parallel download and verification need about 8 GB free storage temporarily; the model is intended for devices with at least 12 GB RAM. It runs locally and offline. Gemma Terms apply. The files are from a third-party mirror; APK Editor Plus is not affiliated with Google.
Download or import a LiteRT-LM model in Settings first.
This language already exists. To protect existing translations, a full translation can only be saved as a new language. Choose another destination language.
No strings found for the selected source language, or no model selected.
Source language: %1$s\nChoose the language to translate INTO
%1$d strings. First 10 shown; styled strings and references remain unchanged. Review all strings after saving.
Language saved. Review the translation before building.
Nothing has been saved. Check the translation and speed before running the full translation.
Cancelling… The current model operation must finish first.
There is no translation diagnostic yet.
Diagnostics copied. It includes device details and timings, but no resource text or file paths.
Replace matching translations? Other strings in this language will be kept. Review the result before building.
Save or resolve pending target-language edits before replacing translations.
%1$d strings could not be safely translated. Existing translations are kept; new languages retain the source text. Resource names (first 20):

All strings are shown below. Tap a row to edit it before saving. Your corrections are stored privately on this device and reused for matching text and language pairs. Styled strings and references remain unchanged.
Not translated — tap to correct; existing target will be kept otherwise
Unchanged — tap to edit where supported
Styled strings and resource references cannot be edited here.
Keep all placeholders and use valid text.
Choose the actual language of these source strings
This target language is not supported by Google ML Kit. Choose another target language.

Translation runs on your device. Google ML Kit may download language models (about 30 MB per language) over your current connection. Translation quality can vary; check the result. Translations are provided as is and do not replace human translators. Continue?
The source and target languages are the same. Choose the actual language of the source text to translate it.
Firefox translation requires Android 9 or later and a 64-bit arm64 process.

Translation runs on your device. Firefox language-pair models may be downloaded from Mozilla using your current connection, typically tens of megabytes per pair. Non-English pairs may require two models. Some language pairs are unsupported. Continue?
